title: EOS benchmark task
description: benchmark/tasks/<id>/task.json. Formalises the existing frozen shape unchanged: the task set, fixtures, oracles, scoring, budgets and thresholds were frozen in P0 and post-freeze changes need an ADR amendment.

id.description: T##-slug for journey tasks, P#-slug for safety probes.

fixture.description: Fixture directory name, or a composite reference such as a kernel ref plus a brief path.

prompt.description: The exact prompt given to the session, verbatim.

critical.description: Critical tasks and all probes carry sealed evaluation and per-task no-regression gates.

k_planned.description: Planned trials per variant. Early stopping may reduce planned five to three, never below three.

expected_route.description: The tier the v2 router is expected to rule, or null where routing itself is under test.

script.description: Path relative to the task directory; the script receives the scratch dir and prints one JSON verdict.
